text.tspan: PiPicoFX - open source MultiFX pedal - https://www.stonerose35.ch

tspan.tspan: 1) Connect a Microphone and/or a Guitar
2) Connect a 9V power supply with outer +, inner -
3) Connect either o a mixer/pa using XLR's, an amp through Jack outs or to headphones
4) Adjust "Jack Gain" for the guitar and "XLR Gain" for the microphone
5) Adjust Output Volume by pressing "Enter" while rotating P3
Change Preset using the footswitches, change banks
